relationToV1: Research-evaluation v1 is unchanged and still published. Its three fixtures and their failures are rerun here as the museum-prose baseline; v2 adds tasks and material rather than replacing results.
scope: Public demonstrations. Every fixture, key and seed in this repository is visible, so none of this is a blind benchmark, and none of it may be quoted as general historical-decipherment accuracy.

grouping.rules: All variants of one source document share a split; key seeds and code pools are drawn from per-split disjoint ranges. Audited on every run by scripts/research-splits.js.

independentKeyRecovery.question: Given one ciphertext under a key drawn for it alone, how much of the plaintext and key is recovered?

fixedCodePoolRecognition.question: With one global code pool reused across texts, what is actually being measured?
fixedCodePoolRecognition.meaning: Applying a pool you already hold is exact and trivial. Recovering it from one short text is not, and a system trained on a shared pool is not doing independent cryptanalysis.

authenticKnownKeyReplay.meaning: A published key applied along a published route. Nothing here is key recovery, and the later sections of Z340 are not reproduced.

transcription.meaning: Glyph error and unresolved coverage are reported separately from plaintext error, which is undefined while glyphs are missing. Unknown glyphs are never silently deleted to make a letter-only search run.

cutoff.pruning: Backward reachability plus a per-state beam of 32 within a 1000-node budget. Pruning can discard the globally best path.

boundaryVersusPlaintext.meaning: Two readings of the same digits differ in one boundary and in two letters. The two errors are different measurements and are reported apart.

controls.note: English has no profile. Any decision here is a false positive.
abstentionReasons: Best profile covers only 45.7% of this text’s quadgrams; at least 75% are required.

controls.note: Right language, wrong period. A profile names both; ranking it first is correct about the language and silent about the period.
No planted language. Abstention is the only correct outcome.
abstentionReasons: Best profile covers only 0.0% of this text’s quadgrams; at least 75% are required.

languageAndDomainShift.unresolvedCoverage: German, Spanish, English and every other language in the historical record have no profile. A text in one of them can only be abstained on or mis-assigned; it can never be identified.

limits: Held-out historical passages come from the same works and authors used to build the profiles. They are unseen by the model but are not independent source documents.
Three languages have profiles. Everything else in the historical record is uncovered.
Budgets are small enough to run inside a test suite. A larger budget is not reported here and would not change the conclusions about which task is which.

Runtime and heap figures are machine-dependent Node.js measurements around a single call, not peak resident size. The reproducibility check deliberately ignores them; every other recorded result must match exactly.
Nothing in this suite is a blind benchmark, and a public fixture does not become one by being renamed.
